quotes.text: I believe the world should accept the 'bad things' that result from allowing me to take other people's property, because of all the good I'd do with the money. Except AI won't even feed hungry children — it will only make the rich richer and flood the internet with slop.
quotes.author: DarkWiiPlayer
quotes.source: Hacker News — Accept 'bad things' in return for benefits of AI, says Sam Altman
quotes.extraction_note: The theft analogy makes the argument absurd on its face, then the punchline undercuts it further. Strong, sharp, and funny.
